seg.seg_rev_note: Two segments: Freight and Transit. 2024 product-line realignment (immaterial) recast 2023 comparatives in later filings; 10-K 2024 adopted ASU 2023-07 with segment GP/SG&A/engineering/amortization detail.
seg.notes: corp_op = 'Corporate Activities and Elimination' income (loss) from operations from the 10-Q segment note. Segment reported->adjusted items (Appendix G): Freight Restructuring and Portfolio Optimization costs: GP 2, OI 10; Freight Non-cash Amortization expense: GP 0, OI 67; Transit Restructuring costs: GP 5, OI 8; Transit Non-cash Amortization expense: GP 0, OI 6 Sales-change reconciliation shows only Acquisitions / Foreign Exchange / Organic (no separate divestiture/portfolio-optimization row); divest = null. 2024 releases: during Q1-24 management moved certain businesses between product lines/segments; 2023 comparatives in 2024 releases are recast (e.g. Q1-23 Freight 1,556 vs 1,566 originally). Values here are as reported in this period's own release.

is.notes: dps = quarterly dividend per share from the 10-Q three-month equity statement. Release rounds to $ millions. other_inc row label: 'Other (expense) income, net'. No discontinued operations (disc_ops 0); cont_ops = net income.

ngaap.guidance: Wabtec raised and tightened its 2024 adjusted EPS guidance to be in the range of $7.45 to $7.65. Wabtec’s revenue guidance range remains unchanged at $10.25 billion to $10.55 billion. For full year 2024, Wabtec expects operating cash flow conversion of greater than 90 percent.
ngaap.notes: Wabtec 'adjusted' results exclude restructuring (Integration 2.0 and Portfolio Optimization) costs and non-cash intangible amortization expense, each tax-effected. EBITDA = income from operations + other income (expense) + D&A; Adjusted EBITDA adds the restructuring costs shown in the EBITDA table (excludes restructuring already within D&A, e.g. accelerated depreciation/asset write-downs, so it differs from the adjusted-table restructuring add-back). Cash conversion table D&A (incl. deferred debt cost amortization): 134; operating cash flow conversion 542/(286+134).
